## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8ca6f396fcba3268c20aa1d676e62e3b61fd21ae`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md, docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md, docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md + packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts (N-08, merged from PR #28467 head `743ac88b`: the `overrides` schema and its `.describe()` strings), packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts (`isCustomizationPairOf`), scripts/adr-index.mjs (the one `**Status**:` line the index reads), docs/adr/README.md (index row for ADR-0146, unchanged), card #28410 (N-09, the first consumer of the gate text)

Inputs read: card #28390 body and every comment (ruling 6542177429; scope 6543281223; scope 6550188803, which carries follow-up (c) of the N-08 ruling 6549129352 on #28404; claim 6550291768; dev report 6550564780), PR #28486 body and file list, `git diff origin/main...refs/review/pr-28486` (3 files, +63/−36, one commit, base `82b29fe5`), and the check-runs on `8ca6f396`. Live `main` (`9b4d1933`) has changed none of the three files since the PR base (the only `docs/adr` change since is ADR-0011), so the diff applies as reviewed; N-08 (#28467) is on `main`, so the first consumer below is the merged one.

Check-runs on the head, read 2026-10-31T23:32Z and again at 23:34Z — these conclusions are the gate verdicts: **success** — Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter, Lint & Repo Gates and every Lint lane (ESLint; docs & code guards; repo & tooling gates; PM dispatch-gates; CI, release & engine gates; scoped ×3; tooling self-tests), Type Check (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger, TypeScript Type Check), Plan Test Core shards, Test Core (all 8 shards; 1/8 was still running at the first read, completed by the second), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. Skipped by path filter — the build, UI, E2E, Temporal, packed-tarball and opt-in harness jobs. At 23:34Z no check-run on the head was running or non-green.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, each judged. The diff publishes no code and no spec; what it changes is the text N-09 (#28410) and N-10 implement from.

1. **Admit a declared override from the paired `.custom` alone** (D2 :199–200, :222–223; D8 item 2 :424; D9 item 1 :450; Supersede rows ADR-0126 D1 :542 and §7.1 :544; N-09 row :628). Right — ruling A, maintainer 「同意」 on 6542177429; matches the merged N-08 `.describe()` ("Only an item of the base's paired `.custom` package declares an override") and the `isCustomizationPairOf` docblock ("ruling A").
2. **Refuse a dependent that carries `overrides` at publish, at `os validate` and at the install door** (D2 :224–225; N-09 row :629 "a dependent's declaration"). Right — the ruling's "三处都拒绝", mirrored on D10's three points for `__c`, and N-09's items 2(b) and 3 say the same.
3. **Undeclared same name inside the closure: the pair's refusal names "declare or rename", any other dependent's names "rename"** (D2 :219–221; Q1 row :571; ADR-0048 §3.4 row :548; ADR-0048 :3). Right — ":210「the refusal names both fixes」只对 `.custom` 成立".
4. **"One declarer per base item / a second declarer refused naming the first" is gone** (main :212–214 and :603–604 replaced). Right — rider 3 withdrawn; the two remaining phrases (head :19, :223) record the withdrawal and admit nothing.
5. **The overrider is fixed by role, never by publish order; the layered read keeps two layers, `override` = the `.custom` item** (D2 :225–227; D8 item 2 :422–423 unchanged). Right — option A's stated effect; option B's third layer is not written anywhere.
6. **Flow precedence arms `.custom`'s declaration only; a dependent's flow row, declared or not, is refused at publish** (D9 item 1 :449–451). Right — ruling A for D9.1 ":433–434 改为「from `.custom`」".
7. **`basedOn` records the base package's `manifest.version`, recorded and never judged** (shape :203, prose :209–210, D11 migration :517, status :20, Refs :700). Right — N-08 ruling follow-up (c); the merged schema's `basedOn.describe()` reads "the base package's `manifest.version` this override was taken from … not a history version of the item", and D2 now says the same. The "recorded, not judged" sentences (:210–212, :393, :669–671) stand as the epic's *Not in this epic* line requires. No sentence in the three files still says an item version (grep for item-version phrasing: zero hits).
8. **`action`: the ledger switch is landed (#27842, #27504 closed 2026-10-30); an undeclared same-name `action` in a dependent is refused like any overridable kind, rename the only fix until the action door opens; no door in this epic** (D9 :477–485; D2 type list :247). Right — scope 6543281223 items 1–2; consistent with N-09 "`action` stays refused for the whole epic".
9. **Cost on record: a partner ships a different base view under its own name via its navigation contribution (ADR-0029 D7); a real partner need reopens #28390 as option B with evidence** (D2 :227–229; Consequences :598–601). Right — the ruling's last bullet, verbatim in intent.
10. **Gap 3 cost: a base upgrade that adds a name a `.custom` item already holds displaces that item (undeclared, so no longer served — D8 items 1–2); no door judges a base upgrade today (ADR-0141 D3 deferred); N-09 names each collision at the install/upgrade door, N-10 surfaces the orphan** (Consequences :602–606). Right — scope item 3 as worded. N-09's item 4(a) also names "a dependent"; the ADR names `.custom` only, as the scope item does — a dependent's same-named item is already refused by rule, so nothing is missing.
11. **Pointer lines**: ADR-0048 :3 owner clause narrowed to "the declared override its paired `.custom` publishes", its §3.4 half split into pair (declare or rename) and other dependent (rename); ADR-0126 :3 "(or in a dependent package that declares it)" dropped and the §7.1 parenthetical narrowed to the pair. Right — see ③ for the narrowing-versus-drop question.
12. **Public surface**: none. No `packages/**`, no `.changeset`, no skill, no `content/docs` file in the diff.

### ② Semver level

The diff is three `docs/adr/**` files; it publishes nothing from any released package, so `skip-changeset` is the correct label and the Check Changeset gate agrees (success). `Clause-②: no` on the PR body, with no arm — well-formed and right: no published clause widens or narrows in this diff. The narrowing of who may declare reaches authors only through N-09's gate (its own PR, its own declaration), and the `overrides` key itself shipped on `main` under N-08's `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right for the same reason. There is no changeset body, so the two declaration lines live on the PR body alone, which is the shape for `skip-changeset`.

Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions[0] — ADR-0048 :3: narrow the owner clause to the pair, or drop it literally?** Answered: **A, keep the narrowing; it stays inside ruling A.** The ruling applies the card's list "verbatim in intent", and the intent of the ADR-0048 item is the same as every other item: remove the closure-wide declarer. The clause on `main` reads "that package, or the declared override a package in its dependency closure publishes"; the part A withdraws is "a package in its dependency closure", not the override itself. A literal drop would make the pointer say the only owner of a shipped name is the shipping package, which contradicts D8 item 2 (the declared override is served within the base's address), contradicts ADR-0146's own §3.3 Supersede row (:547, "that package, or its declared override in `.custom`" — a residue the ruling itself says is true as written and needs no edit), and leaves "outside that closure" in the same sentence with no antecedent. The narrowing is the one edit that is both A and consistent. No escalation is owed: the PR body already surfaces the one-clause revert for the maintainer, whose hand-merge is the acceptance act on this Tier H surface.
- **Acceptance note — D8.2's second sentence** (head :424–426). Inside A. The ruled item is :408 ("the `.custom` item that declares it"); the next sentence on `main` refused only an item "without the declaration … the pair and every other dependent alike", rider 3's shape, which under the new first sentence would imply a declared dependent item still has a place. The rewrite restates D2 and adds no rule; it is the ruled item completed, not a new one.
- **Acceptance note — ADR-0048 :3, §3.4 half.** Inside A. On `main` it read "a dependent package's item bearing a base item's name is a declared override (one declarer per item) or is refused" — rider 3 verbatim in a pointer line. Leaving it would leave a sentence saying a dependent may declare, the exact residue the ruling withdraws. Required to reach A.
- **A third beyond-list edit the Acceptance notes do not count** (the PR table does): D2's cost sentence, `main` :218–219 "when the dependent is not overriding the base's" → head :233–234 "under ruling A renaming is also a dependent's only route to a different version of a base item". Inside A — the old clause presupposed a dependent can override. And D2's type-list tense touch (`main` :231 → head :247 "its ledger switch landed 2026-10-30") is scope item 2 applied where the same sentence recurs. Neither needs the maintainer; the body's count of two is merely short by one, immaterial to the tree.
- **Dev flags**: "Options B and C were not taken" — confirmed, no B third layer and no C cost paragraph anywhere. "Residue grep leaves :19 and :223 only" — reproduced on the head text (same two lines, both withdrawal sentences). `docs/adr/README.md` unchanged — confirmed: `scripts/adr-index.mjs` reads only the line that starts `**Status**:` (line 3), and the amendment pointer sits in the following lines of that paragraph. The harness assignee step skipped — a process note, nothing in the tree.
- **Premise** (card: the five quoted lines still on `main`): re-read on `main` at the PR base and at live `main` — all as quoted; line numbers had not drifted; the three files are unchanged on `main` since the base.

### ④ Design judgment

**docs/adr/0146-…md** — every item of ruling A, scope 6543281223 and scope 6550188803 walked against `main` and the head:

| Ruled item (main line) | Head | Judged |
|:--|:--|:--|
| D2 :188–189 partner sentence deleted | :196–197 "adds items under its own names; it never declares an override" | applied |
| D2 :191–192 "an item of the base's paired `.custom` package" | :199–200 | applied, verbatim in intent |
| D2 :212–214 closure paragraph; :210 both-fixes for `.custom` only | :219–229 | applied, with the three refusal points, role-not-order, cost and the option-B reopen |
| D8.2 :408 "the `.custom` item that declares it" | :424 | applied |
| D9.1 :433–434 "from `.custom`" | :450 | applied |
| Supersede :524 / :526 / :530 | :542 / :544 / :548 | applied; §3.3 row :547 left as is, true under A |
| Q1 :553 | :571 | applied |
| Consequences :580 | :598–601 | applied |
| N-09 row :603 | :628–629 | applied: "admit declared (from `.custom`) … / a dependent's declaration" |
| Scope 1 — D9 action paragraph | :482–483 | applied, in the scope's words |
| Scope 2 — D9 tense | :478–479, :485 "came first"; :247 | applied |
| Scope 3 — gap 3 in Consequences | :602–606 | applied, with D8 items 1–2, ADR-0141 D3, N-09 and N-10 named |
| Scope 6550188803 — `basedOn` L195 / L201 / L499 | :203 / :209–210 / :517 | applied; L282 (:298), L571 (:589), L644–646 (:669–671) re-read, no item-version wording |
| Status line and Refs (Prime Directive #13) | :15–23, :699–700 | amendment pointer naming both ruling records and the scope comment |

Residue hunt beyond the named lines, on the whole head text: the only "closure"/"declarer" phrases left are :19 and :223 (withdrawal sentences) and Context §5 :113 ("whichever package wrote second" — the measured defect, not a rule). D2 heading, D3, D6 (:393), D8 closing sentence (:441–442, "the shipping package or its declared override"), D9 item 3 (:462 "whichever definition is armed" — base or override, not a declarer), D10, D11 and the acceptance list (:669–671, :679) say nothing that admits a dependent's declaration or names an item version. The D4 bullet :364 ("the action ledger switch is out of this epic") stays true after scope item 2 — it landed outside the epic — and D9 :478–479 says the same.

Against the first consumers: the merged N-08 schema's `package.describe()`, `basedOn.describe()`, the `overrides` field description and the `isCustomizationPairOf` docblock each say what D2 now says, word for word in substance. The N-09 card's Wanted list (admit from the pair; refuse 2(a)–(e); three gate points; upgrade collisions named) is derivable from D2, D8, D9 and the N-09 row without reading anything the card says ADR-0146 "currently" says — the card's "implements ruling A, not the ADR's current text" caveat becomes moot once this lands.

Findings:
- **Should-fix (wording, no rule at stake)**: D8 item 2 :426 says a dependent's declared item "is refused when its package publishes ([D2])", while D2 :224 names three points for a dependent carrying `overrides` (publish, `os validate`, install door). The citation to D2 keeps it from contradicting; a reader of D8 alone sees one door. "refused at the doors [D2] names" would close it. Not a must-fix.
- **Nit**: D9 item 1 :450–451 "An *undeclared* row …, and a dependent's row declared or not, is refused" — compound subject, singular verb. Cosmetic.
- **Note (no change asked)**: the "Amended in place" pointer sits in the lines after the one `**Status**:` line (one Markdown paragraph, :3–:23); the index keyword stays "Accepted" and `README.md` is unchanged, which is the intended effect.
- **Out of scope, for the spec lane**: the merged N-08 file `packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts` still carries, in the `OverrideDeclarationSchema` docblock, "which version of that item the author started from", while its `.describe()` says `manifest.version`. Residue in the consumer, not in this diff; no bearing on this verdict.

**docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md** — one line (:3). The §3.3 pointer now names the pair as the only declared owner beside the shipping package, and the §3.4 pointer splits the pair (declare or rename) from any other dependent (rename), citing #28364 and #28390. Both halves agree with ADR-0146's §3.3 and §3.4 Supersede rows (:547, :548) and with D8 item 2. "Packages with no dependency relation keep §3.3 and §3.4 as written" stands. No finding.

**docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md** — one line (:3). "(or in a dependent package that declares it)" dropped as ruled; the §7.1 parenthetical narrowed to "from the paired `.custom` only"; the rest of the pointer (D1, D4 wall 1, lock, ledger switch, walled gate, §7.4, §9) untouched. Agrees with the §7.1 Supersede row (:544). No finding.

No must-fix. The tree applies every item of ruling A and both scope additions, completely, and nothing beyond them except the four consistency edits judged inside A above.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按你对 #28390 裁的 A 修订 ADR-0146：只有基础包配对的 `<base>.custom` 能声明覆盖。伙伴或其他依赖包只能用自己的名字新增；依赖包里和基础包同名的项只有改名一条路，带 `overrides` 声明的依赖包在发布、`os validate`、安装三处都被拒。另外三项补充也写进去了：D9 的 action 段（同名 action 一样拒，只能改名）、D9 的时态（action 台账切换已在 10-30 落地）、代价清单加缺口三（基础包升级新增的名字若与 `.custom` 里的项同名，会顶掉它）。`basedOn` 改为记录基础包的 `manifest.version`，不再是条目版本。ADR-0048 和 ADR-0126 的指针行同步收窄。
- 为什么改：rider 3（闭包里任何包都能声明、先到者独占）会让伙伴先发布就夺走客户的定制权，你裁了 A 撤回它。`basedOn` 一条来自 N-08 的裁决（#28404，6549129352），PR #28467 已按这个意思改了 schema 说明。
- 风险与回滚：只改 ADR 文本，不碰代码与 spec。N-09（#28410）按这版文本实现门禁。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：ADR-0146 的 D2 声明段（约 :219–229）和 Consequences（约 :598–606）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "one declarer" docs/adr/0146-*.md`，只剩两处说明 rider 3 已撤回的句子。
- 需要你做的：`docs/adr/**` 属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准或你亲手合并。契约复审 PASS 记录 6550660808，Head-sha `8ca6f396`。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，裁决 A 与两项补充逐条落实，没有多出未裁的规则。dev 问 ADR-0048 :3 是收窄还是照字面删除，复审支持收窄：照字面删会和 D8 以及本 ADR 的 §3.3 替代行矛盾，收窄后语义就是 A。一条建议修改不在本 PR 改：D8 第 2 条写依赖包的声明「发布时被拒」，D2 写的是三处被拒，这里有引用 D2，不构成矛盾。另有一处残留在已合并的 N-08 代码里：`override-declaration.zod.ts` 的 docblock 仍写「条目版本」，`.describe()` 写的已经是 `manifest.version`，属于 spec 车道。可以批准。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:skills#1` · head `8ca6f396` · 2026-10-31T23:38Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28390`, draft, base `main`, 3 files (`docs/adr/0146-…`, ADR-0048 :3, ADR-0126 :3), +63/−36, `skip-changeset`. No code, spec, skill or docs path.
2. **Ruling:** A `6542177429`, scope `6543281223`, scope `6550188803` (from the N-08 ruling `6549129352`); every item walked line by line in the review record's ④ table. B and C not written anywhere.
3. **Contract review:** PASS `6550660808` at this head (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** dev report `6550564780`: 21 derived gates exit 0, `--ran` reconciled, `adr-index --check` 0. On head `8ca6f396`: 46 check-runs, 26 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed or running; mergeable, clean.
5. **Accepted deviations:** ADR-0048 :3's owner clause narrowed to the paired `.custom` instead of dropped literally (inside A; a literal drop contradicts D8 item 2 and the §3.3 Supersede row). Four consistency edits beyond the ruled list (D8.2 second sentence, ADR-0048 :3 §3.4 half, D2's cost sentence, D2's type-list tense), each judged inside A. Should-fix left as is: D8 item 2 names one refusal point and cites D2 for the three. Out of scope, for the spec lane: the `OverrideDeclarationSchema` docblock in `packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts` still says an item version.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28486` reports GOVERNED, Tier H (`docs/adr/**` ×3). The seat readies the PR and the relay's governed-review leg requests the approvers. No auto-merge is armed by the seat. After an authorized approval, the seat lands it, or the maintainer enqueues it.
